arg.activate: Request adding and selecting LMM; this does not mean the plan was applied
arg.add_only: Add LMM without changing the current selection
arg.all: Use only installed, supported targets; updates also require management permission
arg.dry_run: Create a plan without making changes
arg.fix: Request an authorized LMM configuration repair; do not bypass capability checks
arg.instance: Explicit local instance root; do not scan remote or Docker instances
arg.issuer: Trusted LMM HTTPS origin; specify explicitly for self-hosted servers
arg.json: Print structured JSON without CLI interaction or configuration contents
arg.lang: Interface language: en or zh-CN; otherwise use the locale environment, then English
arg.no_browser: Print the login link; the browser must still reach this machine through loopback
arg.non_interactive: Do not wait for input when a target or authorization is missing
arg.report: Create a shareable summary without paths or configuration contents
arg.software: Exact software ID, such as astrbot or cc-switch
arg.yes: Confirm the shown scope, not account changes, provider switches, or paid tests
blocker.adapter: This version has no verified write adapter for the target software.
blocker.application_grant: CLI login permits catalog and balance reads only. Independent authorization for target applications is not yet implemented.
blocker.compatibility: The software version, configuration manager, and actual request path have not been verified.
blocker.install: A verified software version, verified download source, and installation adapter are required.
blocker.restore: The target change journal and native transaction adapter are not connected. A backup cannot be used to overwrite the target.
callback.invalid: Invalid or denied authorization. Return to LMM CLI.
callback.received: Authorization received. Return to LMM CLI to check completion.
cli.about: LMM CLI - provider presets, local inspection, and read-only OAuth
command.catalog: Search the software catalog; entries do not prove compatibility
command.disconnect: Plan disconnection and revocation for one application
command.doctor: Run read-only diagnostics; --fix still requires a verified adapter and permission
command.install: Plan software installation without requiring LMM login
command.login: Sign in with a browser and store credentials in the system credential store
command.logout: Sign out of the CLI without revoking independent application grants
command.models: Read authorized models and prices without calling or selecting a model
command.presets: Search built-in provider presets without reading configuration, credentials, or the network
command.restore: Plan field-level restoration while preserving later user changes
command.run: Plan to start the selected software with its current configuration
command.setup: Plan integration; writes remain blocked until a verified adapter is available
command.status: Inspect the local environment, installation evidence, and verification status
command.sync: Plan an LMM sync while preserving the current provider and model
command.uninstall: Plan removal of managed software; retain data by default
command.update: Plan updates for software explicitly managed by LMM
error.absolute_instance: --instance must be an absolute local path. Remote and container adapters are not available.
error.auth_non_interactive: The system credential store may require interactive unlocking. OAuth commands do not support --non-interactive. No credentials or network were accessed.
error.login_interactive: Login requires browser authorization. Run lmm login in an interactive terminal. Non-interactive mode will not wait or give consent for you.
error.no_selection: No target selected. No changes were made.
error.presets_read: Cannot read the built-in provider presets.
error.target_required: Non-interactive mode requires a software ID or --all. No changes were made.
error.unknown_software: Unknown software ID. Run lmm catalog for exact names.
error.unsupported_instance: Instance selection is not implemented for this software. --instance cannot be ignored.
help.subcommand: Print this message or help for a subcommand
login.authorize:
Authorize LMM CLI in your browser (catalog and balance read access only; no application migration):
{url}
login.browser_failed: The browser could not open automatically. Open the link above in a browser on this machine.
login.success: LMM CLI is signed in. Credentials are in the system credential store. No application invocation permission was granted. Run lmm models to read the catalog.
logout.success: The CLI is signed out. Other application grants were not revoked and cannot yet be listed by this version.
menu.prompt: Enter a number, or press Enter to cancel:
menu.title: Select software to plan an integration. No integration has been verified yet:
models.title: Authorized models. This does not prove application compatibility; final prices depend on usage:
note.all: No automatic integration adapter has been verified. --all has no executable targets. No software was installed or changed.
note.doctor: Diagnostics are incomplete. Only local path evidence was checked. Verify the target instance, version, and configuration manager. No network or paid tests were performed.
note.dry_run: Plan only. Blockers remain; this is not proof of a completed integration.
note.execution: A safe execution adapter is not implemented for this target. No software was started or removed, no configuration was changed, and no grant was revoked.
note.fix: No repair adapter has been verified. No configuration was changed.
note.install: Installation does not require LMM login. A verified installation adapter is not yet available.
note.yes: --yes does not bypass missing capabilities, authorization, or cost limits.
oauth.already_logged_in: A CLI session already exists. Run lmm logout before changing accounts. Application grants will not be migrated.
oauth.busy: Another LMM authorization operation is running, or a secure lock for this user could not be created.
oauth.callback: Cannot bind a local OAuth callback port.
oauth.credential_store: Cannot access the system credential store. Unlock Keychain, Credential Manager, or Secret Service. Plaintext files will not be used.
oauth.invalid_issuer: The issuer must be a canonical HTTPS domain origin without a port, path, query, or credentials.
oauth.invalid_response: The LMM OAuth response did not match the protocol. Authorization stopped.
oauth.network: The LMM network request failed. Check the connection and that the server has enabled the lmm client.
oauth.not_logged_in: Not signed in. Run lmm login first.
oauth.output: Cannot display the login link. Login stopped.
oauth.refresh_blocked: The previous refresh did not complete reliably. The old refresh token will not be replayed. Run lmm logout, then lmm login.
oauth.timeout: Login timed out. No further requests were made.
oauth.unauthorized: The server denied authorization. Sign in again or check that the lmm client is deployed.
oauth.unstored_grant: The new grant could not be stored, and revocation could not be confirmed. Check the LMM CLI grant on the LMM authorization page.
output.blocked: {software}: plan blocked. No configuration changes, paid calls, or restarts.
output.scope: Scope: current user and runtime environment. Checked at: {timestamp} (Unix seconds).
output.target: {software}: installation is unconfirmed; installation and configuration managers are unknown.
output.verification: LMM added/enabled: unknown. Authorization, connectivity, application calls, streaming, and tool calls: not checked.
plan.paid_verification: Paid verification requires explicit consent, a known quote, and a spending limit enforced by the server.
plan.revoked_grant: The application grant was revoked. Explicit consent is required to authorize it again.
plan.unknown_selection: The current provider is unknown. Read the selected instance configuration first.
presets.title: Built-in provider presets (Magpie snapshot {revision}). Configuration and connectivity were not checked. No provider was added.
restore.conflict: The field changed after the LMM edit. Restoration is paused.
restore.duplicate_field: The change journal contains duplicate fields.
restore.invalid_pointer: Cannot locate the parent object of the field to restore.
restore.unsupported_shape: Only individual scalar fields in objects are supported. Collections require a dedicated adapter.
software.astrbot: Agents and bots for messaging platforms
software.cc_switch: Provider configuration management and local routing
software.pi: Terminal agent; an LMM provider is maintained as a separate project
